titles.title: White Patio with Red Door

description: A white rectangle stretches across the composition. Above the rectangle is a thin band of pink sky. A red square sits at the center of the composition above a line of small, rectangular forms. The semiabstract composition depicts a wall with a door in its center and a line of steppingstones on the ground below.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
